title: Rabbi Benai son of Rabbi Ulla
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 54a, saying: “Why is ‘that it was good’ not said on the second day? Because the fire of Gehinnom was created on it.” Hyman says he is not mentioned in Yuchasin and suggests that possibly he is the one mentioned in Beitzah 3b as Ravina son of Rav Ulla.

notes.text: Pesachim 54a names Benaah son of Rabbi Ulla, while Beitzah 3b names Ravina son of Rav Ulla. The proposed identification and the statement about Yuchasin are Hyman’s.
